tasks.short: Investigate wildlife or pollution damage causes and advise owners on prevention.

steps.what: Investigate actual crop, property, habitat or water damage and capture relevant evidence
inputs: actual damage report and affected site
actual owner accounts and physical evidence
outputs: actual captured damage observations, accounts and unresolved facts

steps.what: Locate applicable actual species, habitat or pollution prevention references
inputs: actual captured damage observations, accounts and unresolved facts
actual current prevention and species references
outputs: checked applicable prevention references and uncertainties

steps.what: Determine actual likely damage causes and suitable preventive measures with qualifications
inputs: actual captured damage observations, accounts and unresolved facts
checked applicable prevention references and uncertainties
outputs: actual cause assessment and appropriate prevention advice

steps.what: Advise actual property owners directly on appropriate damage-prevention measures
inputs: actual cause assessment and appropriate prevention advice
actual owner questions and constraints
outputs: actual owner advice and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned investigation and advice notes in the internal record
inputs: actual captured damage observations, accounts and unresolved facts
actual cause assessment and appropriate prevention advice
actual owner advice and unresolved questions
outputs: checked saved actual investigation and advice record

tasks.design: Configure current species/prevention source links in {DOCS}. Retain actual investigation and evidence capture, cause determination, live owner advice and distinct assigned written notes; ordinary internal saving is ungated and fully retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable prevention references can be located repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-source links reduce navigation without determining causes.
tasks.still_hard: Causation and practical prevention depend on actual site evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The warden distinguishes apparent wildlife damage from a different actual cause.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintained prevention-reference links can assist preparation while damage causation and owner advice remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source15 removes three locating points only. Actual reference owner supplies revision, species/context and applicability; warden supplies actual captured observations from55 and checks missing context manually. No free transcript, automated cause attribution or report generation.

Actual assigned notes5 retain writing/checking and ordinary saving; remove/reweight if not owned. Live owner advice is separate from the note. Existing source links get zero credit. No enforcement order or external electronic send is assumed.
unknowns: Which current prevention sources are already linked?
research_questions: Do links retain actual species and site applicability?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 reference-locating points minus0.5 upkeep=2.5. Low: a new pollutant or unfamiliar damage pattern needs fresh research, leaving only0.7 familiar site/prevention-reference locating point removable, minus0.5=0.2. Field investigation, cause assessment, owner advice and actual notes remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Survey hunting areas and compile bag counts to evaluate control measures.

steps.what: Survey actual areas and observe or obtain actual hunter bag counts
inputs: actual survey scope and hunting areas
actual hunters and observed or reported bags
outputs: actual captured bag-count observations with source and context

steps.what: Record and verify actual bag counts, species, dates, areas and possible duplicate reports
inputs: actual captured bag-count observations with source and context
actual survey definitions
outputs: checked actual count records and unresolved count exceptions

steps.what: Compile bag-count figures by checked species, survey area and period definitions
inputs: checked actual count records and unresolved count exceptions
actual survey definitions
outputs: traceable compiled bag-count figures and explicit exclusions

steps.what: Evaluate actual count comparability and effectiveness of control measures
inputs: traceable compiled bag-count figures and explicit exclusions
actual survey effort and control-measure context

steps.what: Write and check actual survey findings and retain the internal control-assessment record
inputs: actual qualified control-effectiveness assessment
traceable compiled bag-count figures and explicit exclusions
outputs: checked saved actual bag-count survey account

tasks.design: Configure count grouping/totals from verified records in the actual wildlife-survey application, OTHER, into {SPREADSHEET}. Retain actual survey and count capture, fresh verified record entry, effectiveness interpretation and complete written findings; ordinary saving is ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bag figures can be grouped and totaled manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native checked grouping rules can compile actual comparable records.
tasks.still_hard: Survey effort, reporting coverage and control effectiveness require actual interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The warden sees that fewer reported bags may reflect less observation rather than effective control.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: verified bag counts can be grouped and totaled by deterministic native rules.

assumptions: Provisional compile25 is actual manual grouping/totals, not existing runtime. Warden observes/obtains counts within45 and records/verifies species, bag, date, area, source and duplicates within15. Missing definitions or potential duplicates require manual resolution; no free sensor or hunter-report feed.

Actual effectiveness assessment10 and written account5 remain. Existing grouping functions get zero new credit. Ordinary saves remain fully retained and ungated. No population estimate, sanction or external report send is inferred from raw count totals.
unknowns: Which actual bag compilation remains manual?
research_questions: Can grouping preserve changed species/area definitions and survey effort?

incremental.description: Maintain count definitions and inspect duplicate/coverage exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 manual grouping/totals points minus1 upkeep=24. Low: changed area/species categories need manual reconciliation, leaving only8 same-definition count-total points removable, minus1=7. Actual surveys, first records, comparability interpretation and written findings remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document damage extent and estimate loss or recommend compensation.

steps.what: Inspect actual damage and capture measurements, ownership context and source evidence
inputs: actual damaged crop, property or habitat
actual owner evidence and site context
outputs: actual checked damage measurements, observations and source evidence

steps.what: Document actual damage extent from checked observations without adding unobserved losses
inputs: actual checked damage measurements, observations and source evidence

loop.input: checked observations, measurements, evidence and known limitations
loop.output: source-linked damage account with unknown extent explicit
loop.check: Warden checks meaning, omitted limitations and invented damage, ownership or causal certainty
loop.stop: Missing observation or two failed revisions returns affected description to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native damage fields first; individual damage descriptions require semantic checks

steps.what: Determine actual loss quantities, applicable values and compensation-assessment assumptions
inputs: actual checked damage measurements, observations and source evidence
actual substantiated valuation references and compensation criteria
outputs: checked loss quantities, value basis and actual eligibility uncertainties

steps.what: Compute loss-estimate arithmetic from actual checked quantities and value assumptions
inputs: checked loss quantities, value basis and actual eligibility uncertainties
outputs: traceable provisional financial loss calculation and exceptions

steps.what: Make actual compensation recommendations and check the complete damage and loss account
inputs: complete source-linked damage-extent draft
traceable provisional financial loss calculation and exceptions
checked loss quantities, value basis and actual eligibility uncertainties
outputs: complete checked actual damage account, loss estimate and compensation recommendation

steps.what: Save the actual checked damage and loss account in the ordinary internal workspace
inputs: complete checked actual damage account, loss estimate and compensation recommendation
outputs: saved actual damage documentation and financial recommendation

tasks.design: Draft only descriptive damage prose in {DOCS} from actual checked observations and configure checked loss arithmetic in {SPREADSHEET}. Retain actual damage inspection, value/eligibility judgements, compensation recommendations and complete account checks; ordinary save1 stays ungated with no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Damage description typing and checked quantity/value arithmetic can repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded observation-grounded drafting and native formulas can remove selected typing and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Extent, valuation basis and appropriate compensation depend on actual evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The warden refuses to treat an unobserved or disputed loss as an established damage quantity.
tasks.altitude: Reduce descriptive typing and manual estimate arithmetic.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked quantity/value arithmetic and bounded observation-grounded prose can assist damage documentation.

assumptions: Provisional description25 removes two typing points, retaining23 substantive documentation/review; compute10 is actual manual arithmetic. Warden performs actual observation/capture35 and chooses verified quantities, valuation source/date and assumptions20. Missing/disputed values stay manual. No free structured inspection evidence.

Actual compensation recommendation and full account checks9 remain. This recommends compensation, not authorizes a payment. Existing formulas/drafting get zero credit. Ordinary internal save1 remains fully retained without approval; no external decision/send is invented.
unknowns: Which actual estimates use substantiated comparable unit values?
research_questions: Can drafting and formulas preserve disputed extent and valuation uncertainty?

incremental.description: Maintain valuation formula checks and inspect description/source implications.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 descriptive typing plus10 arithmetic points minus0.8 upkeep=11.2. Low: unusual habitat loss needs bespoke valuation and careful original description, leaving only2 simple arithmetic points and0.5 routine description point removable, minus0.8=1.7. Inspection, value selection, compensation judgement, whole checks and save remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce defined references, count compilation and estimate preparation while retaining field judgement.
skills_to_grow: Validate count coverage and valuation assumptions
Check damage prose against actual observations
role.ambitious_version: Trace wildlife-control and damage accounts to actual evidence without automating causation or compensation decisions.
